cases.task: In PocketFlow, Node(max_retries=0) and AsyncNode(max_retries=0) silently skip execution. Reject zero or negative max_retries at construction with a ValueError mentioning max_retries. Preserve behavior for positive values. Add a regression test in tests/test_max_retries_validation.py and run the repository tests.

In boltons.strutils, split_punct_ws and slugify split on ASCII punctuation and whitespace but leave Unicode punctuation attached to words. Treat Unicode punctuation (category P*) as a separator too, while preserving Unicode letters and the existing ASCII and whitespace behavior. Add regression tests to tests/test_strutils.py and run that test file.

In more_itertools.recipes.grouper, n=0 or a negative n silently returns an empty iterator. Reject every non-positive integer n with ValueError when grouper is called, for all incomplete modes (fill, ignore, strict). Preserve positive-size behavior and the existing invalid-mode error. Add regression tests to tests/test_recipes.py and run that test file.

In more_itertools.more, chunked(iterable, 0) and sliced(seq, 0) silently return empty iterators. Reject zero with ValueError when either function is called, in both strict and non-strict modes. Preserve positive sizes and chunked(iterable, None). Add regression tests to tests/test_more.py and run its ChunkedTests and SlicedTests; the full test_more.py contains an unrelated 100-thread test that exceeds the current sandbox process limit.
